meta.title: Submitting an empty bid is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Configure the event as an RFQ pricing stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its pricing sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the bid sheet can be opened.
Complete the required buyer-side pricing sheet fields.
Invite the QA vendor needed to test the supplier submission.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Attempt to submit the empty bid and require refusal evidence such as a disabled submit or error message.
Return to the buyer's event page to verify the oracle.
Confirm no vendor response or bid appears on the buyer's RFQ Responses view.
